## Velo Client 1.0 leaves beta on **November 1, 2026**
Everyone who signs in to Velo for the first time during launch week (Nov 1 - 8) gets **1,000 Velo Coins** free.

### Build your own resource pack - right in the game
- **New resource pack menu** (Options > Resource Packs): available and selected packs side by side, search, drag to select and reorder, drop .zip files onto it, **New pack**, **Reload**, editable copies of zip packs. "Classic screen" opens vanilla's.

- **Texture editor**: pencil, brush, eraser, fill, gradient, shapes, picker, shade and dither brushes, mirror drawing; rectangle / ellipse / lasso / **magic wand** selections, move, copy and paste; **GIMP-style colorize** and other filters; animation frames with timing, interpolation and onion skin; PNG import / export; undo / redo.
- **Live 3D preview** of what you paint: blocks on their real models, items as held, entities on their in-game model.
- **Sounds & music**: play every game sound and song in game, trim on the waveform, change volume, speed and fades, replace with your own ogg / mp3 / wav / flac, add variants, set volume / pitch / weight in sounds.json.
- **Code editor** for JSON, pack.mcmeta, shaders and language files: syntax colours, find & replace, JSON checking and formatting.
- **Save & reload** applies the pack and reloads the game's resources.

### Also new
- Velo Shaders: much softer sun - smaller glow, gentler light rays, less haze towards it.
- Title screen: partner servers are in Discover now.

**Downloads:** the Windows `.exe` and Linux `.deb` launchers are attached below once the build finishes. Mod jars for 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.2 and 26.3 (needs Fabric API).

releases.notes:
## Velo Shaders (Beta)
Shaders that run on Minecraft's new Vulkan renderer (26.2 and 26.3, with Sodium) - where Iris/OptiFine-style packs can't:
- Real sun and moon shadows from blocks, players, mobs and cosmetics; your own shadow in first person and on the clouds
- Volumetric clouds, god rays, a new animated sky (sun, moon phases, stars, Milky Way, aurora)
- Coloured block light, handheld light, glowing auras, light sources and particles
- Water and lava of their own, flowing water, wet ground and puddles, underwater and in-lava looks
- Waving leaves, grass and flowers; bloom and colour grading
- 8 presets (Realistic, Cinematic, Golden Hour, Fantasy, Moody, Clear, Vanilla+, Performance) and every detail configurable
- Turned off, nothing of it runs

**Beta:** brand new custom Vulkan shaders, not perfect yet - feedback welcome.

## Anti Coords Leak & Anti Deepslate
- Coordinates hide themselves while Discord shares your screen - chat, F3, HUD, minimaps, Litematica (incl. the area editor), any mod; chunk and region numbers too. FPS, GPU names and other numbers stay readable.
- Anti Deepslate draws deepslate, stone types, gravel, ores and bedrock as one plain block so their rotation and seed patterns can't give your base away.

## Fixes & improvements
- 26.3: fixed the crash when joining a world, the Singleplayer/menu crash and a startup crash
- Locker skin changes apply on servers and in singleplayer right away; the launcher head follows your current skin
- Launcher 3D character shows the outer skin layer in its real colours; less memory while idle
- Mod buttons (e.g. Flashback's Replays) styled like the rest of the title menu, which now fits small windows
- GPU Utilization HUD shows real numbers; new `/velo toggle <module>`; Anti Farm Lag off by default
- Vulkan frame pacing and startup improvements; Discord overlay on Windows; schematics as .litematic

releases.notes:
**Hotfix for 0.9.9 - please update.** Hosting and joining worlds need 0.9.91.

### World Hosting
- Fixed friends getting "Failed to connect" when joining a hosted world (the world was already open to LAN, e.g. through another mod's hosting, and Velo used the wrong port).
- Velo now checks the connection through the relay before Minecraft connects - problems show a clear message instead of "Failed to connect". The host gets told when someone couldn't get in.
- The mod check before joining only lists mods that add something to the world. Libraries like `annotations` / `kotlin-stdlib` and server-side-only mods are no longer listed as "missing".

### Name Styles
- Name Styles now show in the tab list even when another mod takes over how tab list names are made.

### Partner servers
- HD icons up to 512x512; clients get a sharp copy at the size they draw.
- The owner web panel can now add, edit, remove and reorder partner servers.

### Updates
- Launchers from 0.9.91 open the update dialog by themselves when the team marks an update as required.
